propositions: Free-text JSON extraction from model replies remains heuristic and vulnerable to schema-valid decoys outside the payload region, requiring an explicit output channel to establish a stated contract for payload location.

The directive must instruct the model to wrap its single JSON object between line-anchored sentinel markers (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> and <<<END>>>) with each marker alone on its own line, and extraction must recognize markers only when line-anchored to prevent content/marker collision.

When complete marker blocks are present, extraction must iterate blocks in reverse document order and return the first validated result; if no block validates, it must raise the last block's error (fail-closed) rather than fall through to full-reply selection.
A reply with no complete marker blocks must fall back byte-for-byte to schema-filtered full-reply selection, preserving backward compatibility with legacy and non-compliant transcripts.
The bounded-retry prompt in structured_run.py must name the same markers as the first attempt to ensure the fail-closed retry channel matches the initial directive instruction.

Markers are recognized by line-anchored pairing (left-to-right, next-close, non-nested): OPEN...OPEN...END yields one block; OPEN...END...OPEN...END yields two (last wins); trailing OPEN with no END contributes no complete block.
